Dear [Miss North](/person/1090),
I hope the translation of 'Mulhause' is ready as this is the time at which it ought to be sent to the printers. I hope you were thanked for the Hints on Reading but my time is much taken up at present by my [mother](/person/1606)’s infirm state, and a friend who was staying here wrote for me. I think if possible it would be best to avoid French idioms in English

Yours sincerely

C M Yonge
